content: pkgdown navbar: the articles: section in _pkgdown.yml controls auto-grouping; each section has title (required), desc (optional), navbar (optional label — omit to hide from navbar), contents (required list). To add new distinct dropdown menus (e.g. Learn/Methods and Gallery), add new named keys to navbar: components: and add those keys to navbar: structure: left:. Dropdown syntax: use menu: list under the component, with {text:, href:} for items, text-only entries as headings, and 'text: -------' as separators. The articles: auto-dropdown is separate from custom navbar components — you can override the articles component entirely by redefining it in navbar: components:.
